topics.name: Project to Merit Evidence Boundary
topics.purpose: Define the explicit boundary from Project outcomes/participation evidence into MeritCore so Project itself never calculates merit and MeritCore never rewrites Project history.

semantics.source_rule: Project owns work definition/state/outcome and related evidence refs.
semantics.merit_rule: MeritCore consumes accepted Project evidence through explicit backend operation.
semantics.no_calculation_rule: Project does not calculate points, Tier, recommendations or trust.
semantics.no_rewrite_rule: MeritCore does not rewrite Project definition/history to fit scoring outcomes.
semantics.atom_rule: Time/evidence atoms passed to MeritCore preserve actual work distribution and cannot be multiplied by Project splitting.
semantics.identity_rule: Evidence retains participant identity, Project identity and provenance.
semantics.public_rule: Public Project ranking/projection may derive from Merit outcomes without creating a separate leaderboard primitive.

invariants.rule: Project is the universal recursive work primitive; task-like semantics are represented by Projects rather than parallel task entities.

hard_gates.condition: splitting child Projects multiplies identical evidence
separate leaderboard primitive created where derived ranking suffices

references.purpose: Time evidence cannot multiply through splitting.
